name: @rajpra808/browser-agent
description: Vision-based browser automation CLI — LLM sees screenshot, clicks coordinates, no selectors. Supports Claude, Gemini, OpenAI, Ollama.

scripts.postinstall: node -e "if(process.env.CI!=='true'&&process.env.CI!=='1'){try{require('child_process').execSync('npx playwright install chromium',{stdio:'inherit'})}catch(e){console.log('[browser-agent] Run: npx playwright install chromium')}}"
